references.text: The commandment to bring the firstfruits of the land's harvest to the house of the Lord, which is the basis for the action described in Deuteronomy 26:10.
Repeats the commandment regarding the firstfruits of the land's produce that must be brought to the house of the Lord.
Instructions on bringing the firstfruits of the harvest as a wave offering to the Lord.
The firstfruits of oil, wine, and grain are to be given to the priests, illustrating the practice of giving the firstfruits to the Lord.
The commandment to bring offerings and firstfruits to the place the Lord chooses.
The firstfruits of grain, wine, and oil are to be given to the priests.
An exhortation to honor the Lord with the firstfruits of all produce.
A prophetic promise of worship before the face of the Lord, reflecting the action of laying the offering down before the Lord.
Believers are described as a firstfruit of God's creatures, linking the concept of firstfruits to the context of the New Testament.
